list.title: Dhisayaasha & Mashaariicda
list.hint: Dhisayaashu waxay galaan marinka wax-dhisaha si ay u aqbalaan tixraacyada mashruucyadooda oo ay u xaqiijiyaan boosaska.

detail.deactivateHint: Deminta isticmaale kasta oo wax dhisaya isla markiiba.
detail.resetPassword: Dib u deji erayga sirta ah
detail.resetPrompt: Furaha cusub ee {{name}} (ugu yaraan 8 xaraf). Meel walba waa laga saxeexi doonaa.
detail.passwordReset: Dib u habaynta erayga sirta ah ee {{name}} .
detail.projectsHint: La-hawlgalayaashi waxay ka soo xushaan mashaariicda firfircoon marka la diiwaangelinayo hogaanka; gudbintu waxa ay aadaysaa kan wax dhisaya.

protection.saved: Ilaalinta nuqul ka mid ah ayaa loo cusboonaysiiyay {{name}} .
protection.hint: Ilaalinta nuqul ka mid ah: 1-3650 maalmood, ama ka tag faaruq si aad u isticmaasho nidaamka caalamiga ah ee Settings. Isbeddelku waxa uu khuseeyaa oo keliya diiwaangelinta cusub - kuwa hadda jira waxa ay hayaan wakhtigooda.

matching.saved: Isku dhafka nuqul ayaa loo cusboonaysiiyay {{name}}
matching.hint: Faahfaahinta ka dhigaysa laba diiwaangelin isku mid ah macaamiisha mashruuca. Isbeddeladu waxay khuseeyaan jeegag nuqul ah hadda ka dib; ilaalinta jira ma saamayso.
